#### What this PR does / why we need it:

#### Special notes for your reviewer:
Adds health check SLI metrics to kubelet. This is behind a feature gate.

```release-note
If `ComponentSLIs` feature gate is enabled, then `/metrics/slis` becomes available on kubelet, allowing you to scrape health check metrics.

```

#### Additional documentation e.g., KEPs (Kubernetes Enhancement Proposals), usage docs, etc.:

This section can be blank if this pull request does not require a release note.

```
# HELP kubernetes_healthcheck [ALPHA] This metric records the result of a single healthcheck.
# TYPE kubernetes_healthcheck gauge
kubernetes_healthcheck{name="log",type="healthz"} 1
kubernetes_healthcheck{name="ping",type="healthz"} 1
kubernetes_healthcheck{name="syncloop",type="healthz"} 1
# HELP kubernetes_healthchecks_total [ALPHA] This metric records the results of all healthcheck.
# TYPE kubernetes_healthchecks_total counter
kubernetes_healthchecks_total{name="log",status="success",type="healthz"} 1
kubernetes_healthchecks_total{name="ping",status="success",type="healthz"} 1
kubernetes_healthchecks_total{name="syncloop",status="success",type="healthz"} 1
```

There is another `healthz.InstallHandler` in `cmd/kubelet/app/server.go`. I'm not sure that this change is needed there as well.

> There is another `healthz.InstallHandler` in `cmd/kubelet/app/server.go`. I'm not sure that this change is needed there as well.

Why would we need to register the path twice? This change has been verified locally, IIUC, so it's probably(?) a moot point.

> > There is another `healthz.InstallHandler` in `cmd/kubelet/app/server.go`. I'm not sure that this change is needed there as well.
> 
> Why would we need to register the path twice? This change has been verified locally, IIUC, so it's probably(?) a moot point.

I misunderstand the health handler of kubelet. The health handler is for `10248/healthz` and we need to add the slis to `:10250/metrics/`.

review_comments:
Should this be moved to here instead? https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/1ab1b0af6e3c6c0527543a72a796045afbdfe887/cmd/kubelet/app/server.go#L113-L115

That seems to be the pattern used elsewhere, e.g. 
https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/1ab1b0af6e3c6c0527543a72a796045afbdfe887/cmd/kube-controller-manager/app/controllermanager.go#L82
https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/1ab1b0af6e3c6c0527543a72a796045afbdfe887/cmd/kube-proxy/app/server.go#L92
It can be there or here, the init functions should evaluate at roughly the same time (though I think the cmd one is slightly sooner).

Added the feature gate initialization in [kubernetes/cmd/kubelet/app/server.go](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/1ab1b0af6e3c6c0527543a72a796045afbdfe887/cmd/kubelet/app/server.go#L113-L115)
I actually think it needs to be in the original spot due to unit tests which do not import the cmd file.
You could init in the unit test, but I think this is fine.

Does this have any interactions with line 387?
```
	s.restfulCont.Handle(metricsPath, legacyregistry.Handler())
```

Does the ordering of these lines matter?
No, ordering between those lines do not matter.
